Hello! I'm AURA, your AI-powered Medical Health Operating System. I'm here to assist with health-related questions, symptom analysis, medication guidance, and clinical reasoning.

**Please note:** I'm an AI, not a healthcare provider. For any diagnosis, treatment decisions, or medical concerns, always consult a qualified healthcare professional. I'm here to support—never replace—clinical care.

How can I help you today? Feel free to share your symptoms, health questions, or concerns, and I'll provide evidence-based information to support your discussion with your provider.
